subject: Rebaseline POC scope — add L2 reranking use case / updated success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood inference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood inference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Rebaseline POC scope — add L2 reranking use case / updated success criteria

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned before we update the SOW:

- New ask: add the L2 reranking use case (search result re-ranking using hybrid embeddings + context-aware scoring). You described ~5k daily queries and 95th pct latency target of 250ms.
- Impact: this adds an inference path and some evaluation work (we'll run 2 model configs: high-accuracy and cost-optimized).
- Proposed success criteria (updated):
  1) P99 serving latency <= 350ms for 95% of test queries;
  2) Reranking NDCG@10 improvement >= 8% vs baseline on your eval set;
  3) Stable per-token cost within 15% of our quoted cost profile for the cost-optimized config.
- Timeline: extend POC by 2 weeks to allow data ingest + eval (new end date: Aug 6).
- Ownership: Redwood will deliver updated SOW and evaluation checklist; Acme will provide gold labels + sample query stream and a small holdout set (we scoped ~10k items).

I'll attach a v2 SOW that reflects the scope change and a short evaluation checklist. If this looks good, I'll send the updated SOW and get procurement looped in.

Thanks — Marissa

Subject: Re: Rebaseline POC scope — add L2 reranking use case / updated success criteria

Alex / Marissa — looping back with the revised technical acceptance criteria and SOW notes. Per Marissa's request we've sketched the split on NDCG impact:~

- Model improvements (new embedding + reranker): expected to contribute ~70–80% of the observed NDCG uplift
- Feature/engineering (session features, click signals): expected to deliver ~20–30%

Operational notes:
- Infra: we can run both configs in parallel on our Dedicated staging cluster. Cost delta estimated ~ $3.6k over the 2-week extension (includes GPU hours + eval runs).
- Data needs: Acme to provide labeled holdout (min 5k, recommended 10k) and sample query stream (CSV) by Jul 26.
- Updated acceptance criteria (final):
  1) P99 <= 350ms for at least 95% of holdout queries;
  2) NDCG@10 improvement >= 8% vs baseline (holdout);
  3) Per-token cost delta <= 15% for cost-optimized config;
  4) Reproducibility: Redwood to provide reproducible eval notebook and logs to Acme for audit.

Attached: Redwood_POC_SOW_v2.pdf (with cost delta) and evaluation_checklist.xlsx (eval steps + data template).

If that all looks good I'll mark the SOW ready and Marissa can send to procurement.

Thanks — Vivek
